items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: They had a fellow named Tommy Crump, a very good tenor saxophone player who had been with Earl Hines' band.

ctx.x: So we get into New York, and we go up to this rehearsal, and here are all... There were a lot of musicians there. I found out that we were to have a 17-piece band. So I'm being introduced to the different people in the band. The reed section was Charlie Parker on alto saxophone. They had a young fellow that was from Kansas City, and everybody called him Junior, but I can't remember what his real name was. [JOHN JACKSON] There was Charlie Parker and Junior on alto saxophones.
